data.one_liner: A Flutter grid that supports both dragging and tapping to select its items.
data.what_it_does: Provides a GridView alternative that enables users to select multiple grid items by tapping or dragging across them. It tracks the selection state via a controller and supports auto-scrolling during drag gestures.
use_when: You need a photo gallery or file manager style multi-selection grid.
Users need to select items by tapping or dragging across multiple items.
avoid_when: You only need a standard non-selectable grid view.
You require complex drag-and-drop reordering rather than item selection.
strengths: Supports both drag and tap selection mechanics out of the box.
Includes auto-scroll capabilities when dragging near the edges of the grid.
weaknesses: Requires writing supplementary custom widgets like selection app bars or item wrappers to achieve a full UX.
API is closely tied to standard GridView.builder patterns.

alternatives.name: flutter_staggered_grid_view
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose this if you need staggered or varying-size grid layouts rather than standard select-to-drag grids.
